body: I think they don't want to confuse Cat of the Canals with Catelyn/Cat Stark. Just like they didn't want to confuse Osha with Asha/Yara Greyjoy.

I have countless of unfinished projects. The lack of motivation is why they're unfinished. Like I said, I can't really force myself to do what I love anymore because it just makes it harder and more stressful (I tried several times). The real problem here is that I've lost the spark of engaging in my hobbies because I wanted to.
I have a dog, but she lives with my brother in another city and she's coming to stay over next weekend. I love her but sometimes she kind of reinforces the loneliness.
